channel.title: OpenAI Research & Releases
channel.description: Latest research papers and model releases from OpenAI

item.title: Amp puts AI agents to work beyond code with OpenAI models
item.description: See how Amp pushes the frontier of what agents can do with GPT-6 Astra, Ultrafast, GPT-Live-1, and Sign in with ChatGPT.

item.title: SentinelOne cuts malware analysis from weeks to hours
item.description: With OpenAI Daybreak, SentinelOne cuts weeks of malware analysis to hours, creating capacity to investigate more threats.

item.title: How Third Moment Research runs 10,000 agents for 36+ hours
item.description: With GPT-6 Astra and GPT-6.1 Sol, Codex, and Daybreak for cybersecurity, this AI lab builds agents that focus for days and improve with use.

item.title: How Block is building AI-powered security with OpenAI technology
item.description: Block is building AI-powered security with OpenAI. Its security team investigates threats faster and proposes patches in minutes.

item.title: The EU’s next chapter in AI is agentic
item.description: New analysis shows how agentic AI adoption is growing across EU enterprises and small businesses—and where deeper use could unlock more value.

item.title: Higgsfield takes AI video from 1 minute to over 10
item.description: Higgsfield brings creators longer videos with GPT-6 Astra, precise visuals with GPT-Image-2.5, and a path to voice filmmaking with GPT-Live.

item.title: Asana cuts model costs 76x in browser tests with GPT-6.1 Sol
item.description: Using GPT-6 Astra in Codex, Asana made its browser agent 76x cheaper and 5x faster in tests to offer customers more capable models.

item.title: Sophos cuts threat investigation time by 96% with OpenAI Daybreak
item.description: Discover how Sophos uses OpenAI’s Daybreak to cut cyber-threat investigation time by 96% and automate 52% of MDR cases while preserving human oversight.

item.title: How Oracle turns days of work into minutes with ChatGPT and Codex
item.description: Across recruiting, engineering, and operations, Oracle turns specialist knowledge into fast, repeatable workflows with ChatGPT Work and Codex.

item.title: Pollo AI turns creative ideas into campaigns with OpenAI
item.description: With GPT-5.6, GPT-6 Astra, and GPT‑Image‑2.5, Pollo AI helps creators turn bold ideas into detailed images and cinematic video ads.

item.title: LegalOn halves Codex costs while maintaining development speed
item.description: LegalOn cut estimated daily Codex costs by 65% while maintaining development speed. It matched Astra, Sol, and Luna to tasks and managed budgets strategically.

item.title: Disrupting AI-enabled “false front” operations
item.description: OpenAI disrupted two AI-enabled influence operations that used false-front journalists and a think tank to spread geopolitical messaging.

item.title: Helping teens learn, plan, and shape the future of AI
item.description: College Planner is coming to ChatGPT for Teens to help students manage college applications, alongside new flashcards, quizzes, and a teen AI council.

item.title: Radisson Hotel Group brings hotel discovery into ChatGPT
item.description: Radisson partnered with Accenture to build a ChatGPT plugin using OpenAI technology, helping travelers find, compare, and book hotels while planning their trips.

item.title: GPT-6 and Intelligent UI for everyone
item.description: GPT‑6 is rolling out globally in ChatGPT with Intelligent UI, delivering faster responses with visuals and interactive experiences you can explore and use directly.

item.title: Atlassian and OpenAI expand partnership to turn enterprise knowledge into action
item.description: Atlassian and OpenAI are expanding their partnership to connect frontier models with enterprise knowledge and help teams plan, build, and deliver work.

item.title: How Jump Trading is scaling quant research with ChatGPT
item.description: Jump Trading uses OpenAI to expand quantitative research. See how longer-running AI workflows combine multiple data sources with human review.

item.title: Sharing AI progress in mathematics
item.description: OpenAI publishes new results on open problems in mathematics from an internal frontier model and shares Lean proof formalizations and research details on GitHub.

item.title: Advancing computer use with Ironclad
item.description: Learn how OpenAI and Ironclad are training and evaluating AI agents on complex contracting workflows to advance computer use for professional work.

item.title: Our approach to EU text provenance rules
item.description: How OpenAI is approaching text watermarking under EU rules. Learn where watermarks apply, how detection works, and why access starts with researchers.
